description: Curated 8-game real-game quality & performance benchmark corpus covering Bullet/Blitz/Rapid/Classical time controls, pre-evaluated Lichess PGN, own punished & escaped blunders, opponent missed & caught tactics, garbage-time non-leakage, multi-solution Arrow Duel vs unique Line routing, and maxPuzzlesPerGame cap enforcement.

games.title: Bullet 1+0: Own hanging-queen blunder punished in time trouble
Blitz 3+0: Impulsive own queen blunder escaped by opponent
Rapid 10+0: Unique back-rank mate-in-2 missed by user -> Line puzzle
Blitz 5+0: User catches opponent back-rank mate-in-2 -> Highlight only, never puzzle
Classical 30+0: Garbage-time blunders (+6 -> +4 for winning user) produce 0 leaks
